title: Password reset: links and support options
summary: Handle expired, replaced or closed links, locked accounts, unavailable email, and a missing authenticator.
scenes: When email or both factors are unavailable

steps.say: Reset links are private and short lived. This example shows the messages you may see when a link cannot be used.
If a link has expired, choose Ask for a new link. Do not keep retrying the expired email.
onScreen: This link has expired. Links work for a short time; ask for a new one.

steps.say: A newer reset request replaces the previous link. Use the newest email, even if older messages arrive later.
An invalid or incomplete link also cannot be used. Open the complete link from the newest email, or request another.
A locked account must wait or be unlocked by an administrator. A password-reset link does not bypass an account lock.
An account that has never enrolled an authenticator cannot reset its password by email. Ask the administrator to verify your identity and help.
Too many wrong verification codes close the link. Ask for a new link or contact your administrator instead of continuing to guess.
actions: Types into Code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code (hidden)

steps.say: If the app is missing but you have an unused recovery code, a fresh reset link can use it as the second factor. The code is then used up.
actions: Types into Code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code (hidden)

steps.say: Some MERIT installations cannot email reset links. Their reset page tells you to contact an administrator after confirming who you are.
onScreen: Reset your password · MERIT can't email reset links here. Contact your MERIT administrator: after confirming who you are, they can set a new password for you. · Lost your authenticator app as well? Contact your MERIT administrator to verify your identity and reset both. · Back to sign in

steps.say: If you have lost both the password and the authenticator, and have no recovery codes, contact your administrator to verify your identity and reset both.
Email never arrives? Check the user name and junk folder, then use your agency support channel. The Check your email page does not prove that an account exists.
After a successful reset, return to the normal sign-in process. Your authenticator still works unless an administrator has reset MFA.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from your authenticator app (hidden)
